title: Pick the cheapest fix that meets the goal
summary: Read which resource is the bottleneck before choosing a cost lever.

choices.text: Enable prefix caching, and route each client's requests to the same replica so the cache hits.
Switch to a paged KV cache to fit more decode sequences.
Serve most requests with a smaller model distilled for summarisation, checked on a held-out set.
Lower the maximum output length from 150 to 100 tokens.
